artifacts.summary: Six-phase, five-wave plan: clean baseline and corpus re-derivation, the two sandbox-validated suite isolations (timing-axis causal assertion and delta-based shared-path check) in parallel, a 153-suite triage ledger plus evidenced known-failures rows, the ambient-host-state convention section, and repeated-run acceptance under demonstrated induced load.

memory_candidates.content: When a task's acceptance criterion is a GREEN aggregate test gate but the corpus carries reproducible defects outside that task's own file_scope, the criterion is discharged through the baseline-manifest mechanism (known-failures.txt + run-all.sh --fail-on-new: zero NEW failures, every EXPECTED row re-validated against live [FAIL] output and given a durable-anchor owner plus a spawned follow-up), NOT by widening scope to fix foreign defects and NOT by weakening the criterion. Record the reinterpretation explicitly in the plan's Risks table rather than leaving it implicit, since a reader otherwise cannot tell a baseline-green gate from a literally-green one.
